proposal_adaptations: Separate evaluator-owned HeldOutTargetBinding metadata is mandatory before the zero-argument label loader so a reference source mismatch can reject without reading labels.
V1 allowlists the exact generated permitted-input fingerprint and the original/zero generated target hashes; crop/normalization/proposals/tools/objective variants require a new version.
HeldOutTargetReference nests the binding and privately owns immutable target bytes; provenance and target-only full-generated-grid coverage are fixed by the version.
Preflight errors raise before loader access; load/reference/replay failures return immutable sealed records that the caller must persist.
Method configuration/parameter identities and accounting are sealed caller declarations; no claim is made to authenticate planner identity or independently measure prior planning costs.
